artworks.title: Lost Pleiad
artworks.description: Bouguereau’s Academic nude is the modern image of the ‘lost Pleiad’ — traditionally Merope, the sister who alone married a mortal (Sisyphus) and whose star shines dimmest. Salon pathos keeps the Atlas daughter distinct from the Messenian queen of Voltaire’s tragedy.

artworks.title: The Pleiades
artworks.description: Vedder’s Metropolitan Museum canvas gathers all seven sisters — Maia, Electra, Taygete, Alcyone, Celaeno, Sterope, and Merope — with one star dulled at the edge. Symbolist star-lore paints Merope inside the cluster that still bears the family’s name.

popCulture.title: Merope (Pleiad)
popCulture.description: One of the seven Pleiades; wife of Sisyphus and mother of Glaucus — the sister whose mortal marriage mythographers link to the dimmest star.
